cohort: 135 neonates with birth weight < 1500 g admitted to the NICU.
finding: Mortality rate was 16.29% in this cohort, with lower gestational age and birth weight being significantly associated with mortality.
gest_age: Mean gestational age was lower for patients who died (27.9 weeks) compared to those who survived (29 weeks).
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was significantly lower for patients who died (842g) compared to those who survived (969g).
